get_model_by_name: get a pretrained Demucs model by name from the remote AWS repo or a local repo directory
get_model_from_args: load a pretrained Demucs model from argparse arguments with name and repo flags
add_model_flags_to_parser: add mutually exclusive model selection flags to an argparse parser for name and repo options
create_unittest_model: create a unit test HDemucs model with 4 channels for drums, bass, other, and vocals sources
parse_remote_files: parse a remote files list text file into a dictionary mapping model signatures to download URLs
